top_violation_types.title: Documentation of Drills (26 TAC §746.5205(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Re-cite: Documentation of drills was not available for review at the time of inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))
Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two infants did not have current infant feeding schedules.

top_violation_types.title: Written Activity Plan - Group Name and Dates (26 TAC §746.2205(a)(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: There were four classrooms being used during inspection.  In the infant classroom, the activity plan did not have the date.  In a second classroom, the activity plan was not for the current week.

top_violation_types.title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Interact positively with children (26 TAC §746.1203(5))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the course of the investigation, the operation was found deficient with this Minimum Standard. A caregiver utilized inappropriate language when referring to a child.

top_violation_types.title: Written Activity Plans (26 TAC §746.2203(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Activity plan was not available for review.

top_violation_types.title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained (26 TAC §746.4907(d))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The proper depth of loose fill is not being maintained on the playground.

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The promotion of Physical Activity was not available for review in the Operational Policies.
